title: Temperature Response Functions for Climate Impact Assessments: The Case of ENSO and Electricity Consumption
Carbon Emissions are Underpriced Due to the Snow Albedo Feedback Effect
abstract: To balance the tradeoff between economic activity and climate goals by internalizing the cost of emissions, integrated assessment models calculate a social cost of carbon. Embedded in such models are physical energy balance climate models that typically employ temporally constant climate parameters. We examine the empirical effects of changing surface albedo over time. To this end, we leverage satellite data since 2001 in a state-space model in conjunction with an adaptation of the reverse Kalman filter to estimate incoming energy less albedo over 1850-2023. The results show a decreasing albedo trend over most of the sample. Our estimates are consistent with the snow albedo feedback (SAF) where melting ice leads to declines in albedo, thereby causing increased heat absorption at the surface and further melting. Together, these findings indicate that the heating effects of carbon emissions are amplified by the SAF, the omission of which in the carbon pricing decision leads to underpricing.
abstract_zh: 为通过内部化排放成本来平衡经济活动与气候目标之间的权衡，综合评估模型计算了碳的社会成本。这些模型中嵌入了物理能量平衡气候模型，后者通常采用随时间恒定的气候参数。我们考察了地表反照率随时间变化的实证效应。为此，我们利用2001年以来的卫星数据，结合状态空间模型，并对逆卡尔曼滤波进行改造，以估计1850–2023年间的入射能量减去反照率的结果。结果显示，在样本期内的大部分时间里，反照率呈下降趋势。我们的估计与雪反照率反馈（SAF）相一致，即融化的冰雪导致反照率下降，从而使地表吸收更多热量，进一步加剧融化。综合这些发现表明，碳排放的增温效应被雪反照率反馈所放大，而在碳定价决策中忽略这一效应将导致碳价被低估。

title: Climate and Sustainable Energy Econometrics and Statistics
Effects of Climate Change on House Prices in Outdoor Tourism Destinations: A Case Study of Southwestern Colorado
abstract: We estimate the historical effects of climate change on real estate prices in the San Juan Mountain Region of Southwestern Colorado, an area strongly influenced by outdoor recreation‐based tourism, and we use these estimates to make projections for future house prices in the region based on multiple anthropogenic climate forcing scenarios. We find that local warm‐season minimum and cold‐season temperature and local warm‐season maximum temperature have significantly positive long‐run relationships with global anthropogenic climate forcing. Moreover, once we control for non‐climate factors that affect the housing market, we find that local cold‐season precipitation and local warm‐season maximum temperature have significant but opposite effects on local house prices. Scenario‐based projections suggest that these two effects largely negate each other under any climate scenario, so that effects of climate change on house prices are expected to continue through the end of the century as they have over the past few decades.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了气候变化对科罗拉多州西南部圣胡安山区房地产价格的历史影响，该地区受户外休闲旅游业的强烈影响。我们利用这些估计结果，依据多种人为气候强迫情景，对该地区未来房价进行预测。我们发现，当地暖季最低温度、冷季温度以及暖季最高温度与全球人为气候强迫存在显著为正的长期关系。此外，在控制了影响住房市场的非气候因素后，我们发现当地冷季降水与当地暖季最高温度对当地房价具有显著但方向相反的影响。情景预测表明，在任何气候情景下，这两种效应基本相互抵消，因此气候变化对房价的影响有望如过去数十年一样持续至本世纪末。

venue: Handbook of Research Methods and Applications in Macroeconomic Forecasting
abstract: Bringing together the recent advances and innovative methods in macroeconomic forecasting, this erudite Handbook outlines how to forecast, including following world events such as the Covid-19 pandemic and the global financial crisis. With contributions from global experts, chapters explore the use of machine-learning techniques, the value of social media data, and climate change forecasting. This title contains one or more Open Access chapters.
abstract_zh: 本手册汇集了宏观经济预测的最新进展与创新方法，阐述了如何进行预测，包括对新冠疫情和全球金融危机等世界事件的跟踪。手册由全球专家撰稿，各章探讨了机器学习技术的应用、社交媒体数据的价值以及气候变化预测。本书包含一章或多章开放获取章节。

title: Introduction to the Themed Issue on Climate Econometrics
Polar Amplification in a Moist Energy Balance Model: A Structural Econometric Approach to Estimation and Testing
abstract: Poleward transport of atmospheric moisture and heat play major roles in the magnification of warming in poleward latitudes per degree of global warming, a phenomenon known as polar amplification (PA). We derive a time series econometric framework using a restricted vector error correction model (VECM) and an identification strategy to recover the parameters of a moist energy balance model (MEBM) similar to those in the recent climate science literature. This framework enables the climate econometrician to estimate and forecast temperature rise in latitude belts as cumulative emissions continue to grow as well as account for effects of increases in atmospheric moisture predicted by the Clausius-Clapeyron equation, which drives spatial non-uniformity in climate change. Non-uniformity is important for two reasons: climate change has unequal consequences that need to be better understood and amplification of temperatures in polar latitudes has a higher potential to trigger irreversible climate tipping points.
abstract_zh: 大气水汽和热量向极地的输送，在全球每升温一度时放大了高纬度地区的增温幅度，这一现象称为极地放大（PA），它在其中起着重要作用。我们推导出一个时间序列计量框架，采用受限向量误差修正模型（VECM）并结合识别策略，以恢复与近期气候科学文献中相似的湿能量平衡模型（MEBM）的参数。该框架使气候计量经济学家能够在累积排放持续增长的情况下，估计并预测各纬度带的温度上升，同时考虑克劳修斯–克拉珀龙方程（Clausius-Clapeyron equation）预测的大气水汽增加效应，而该效应正是导致气候变化空间不均匀性的原因。这种不均匀性之所以重要，有两个原因：气候变化的后果分布不均，需要得到更好的理解；而且极地温度的放大更有可能触发不可逆的气候临界点。

title: Common Trends and Country Specific Heterogeneities in Long-Run World Energy Consumption
abstract: We employ a semiparametric functional coefficient panel approach to allow an economic relationship of interest to have both country-specific heterogeneity and a common component that may be nonlinear in the covariate and may vary over time. Surfaces of the common component of coefficients and partial derivatives (elasticities) are estimated and then decomposed by functional principal components, and we introduce a bootstrap-based procedure for inference on the loadings of the functional principal components. Applying this approach to national energy-GDP elasticities, we find that elasticities are driven by common components that are distinct across two groups of countries yet have leading functional principal components that share similarities. The groups roughly correspond to OECD and non-OECD countries, but we utilize a novel methodology to regroup countries based on common energy consumption patterns to minimize root mean squared error within groups. The common component of the group containing more developed countries has an additional functional principal component that decreases the elasticity of the wealthiest countries in recent decades.
abstract_zh: 本文采用半参数函数系数面板方法，使所关注的经济关系既包含国家层面的异质性，又包含一个共同成分，该共同成分可以是协变量的非线性函数，并可随时间变化。我们估计了系数及偏导数（弹性）中共同成分的曲面，并通过函数主成分对其进行分解；同时，我们提出了一种基于自助法（bootstrap）的程序，用于对函数主成分的载荷进行推断。将该方法应用于各国能源—GDP弹性，我们发现，弹性受两组国家各自不同的共同成分驱动，而这两组成分的主要函数主成分又具有相似之处。这两组大致对应于OECD国家和非OECD国家，但我们采用了一种新方法，依据共同的能源消费模式对国家进行重新分组，以使组内均方根误差最小化。在较发达国家所在组的共同成分中，还存在一个额外的函数主成分，它降低了近几十年来最富裕国家的弹性。

title: Introduction to 'Essays in Honor of Joon Y. Park: Econometric Methodology in Empirical Applications'
Introduction to 'Essays in Honor of Joon Y. Park: Econometric Theory'
Local Climate Sensitivity: What Can Time Series of Distributions Reveal about Spatial Heterogeneity of Climate Change?
abstract: Transient climate sensitivity relates total climate forcings from anthropogenic and other sources to surface temperature. Global transient climate sensitivity is well studied, as are the related concepts of equilibrium climate sensitivity (ECS) and transient climate response (TCR), but spatially disaggregated local climate sensitivity (LCS) is less so. An energy balance model (EBM) and an easily implemented semiparametric statistical approach are proposed to estimate LCS using the historical record and to assess its contribution to global transient climate sensitivity. Results suggest that areas dominated by ocean tend to import energy, they are relatively more sensitive to forcings, but they warm more slowly than areas dominated by land. Economic implications are discussed.
abstract_zh: 瞬态气候敏感性将来自人为及其他来源的总气候强迫与地表温度联系起来。全球瞬态气候敏感性已得到充分研究，与之相关的平衡气候敏感性（ECS）和瞬态气候响应（TCR）概念亦是如此，但空间分解的局地气候敏感性（LCS）则研究较少。本文提出了一个能量平衡模型（EBM）和一种易于实施的半参数统计方法，利用历史记录估计局地气候敏感性，并评估其对全球瞬态气候敏感性的贡献。结果表明，以海洋为主的地区倾向于吸收能量，对强迫的敏感度相对较高，但其升温速度比以陆地为主的地区更慢。文中还讨论了其经济含义。

Long-Term Oil Price Forecasts: A New Perspective on Oil and the Macroeconomy
abstract: We examine how future real GDP growth relates to changes in the forecasted long-term average of discounted real oil prices and to changes in unanticipated fluctuations of real oil prices around the forecasts. Forecasts are conducted using a state-space oil market model, in which global real economic activity and real oil prices share a common stochastic trend. Changes in unanticipated fluctuations and changes in the forecasted long-term average of discounted real oil prices sum to real oil price changes. We find that these two components have distinctly different relationships with future real GDP growth. Positive and negative changes in the unanticipated fluctuations of real oil prices correlate with asymmetric responses of future real GDP growth. In comparison, changes in the forecasted long-term average are smaller in magnitude but are more influential on real GDP. Persistent upward revisions of forecasts in the 2000s had a substantial negative impact on real GDP growth, according to our estimates.
abstract_zh: 本文考察未来实际GDP增长如何与贴现实际油价长期平均预测值的变化相关，以及与实际油价相对于预测值的非预期波动的变化相关。预测基于一个状态空间石油市场模型，其中全球实际经济活动与实际油价共享一个共同的随机趋势。非预期波动的变化与贴现实际油价长期平均预测值的变化之和等于实际油价的变化。我们发现，这两个分量与未来实际GDP增长的关系截然不同。实际油价非预期波动的正向与负向变化，分别与未来实际GDP增长的非对称反应相关联。相比之下，长期平均预测值的变化幅度较小，但对实际GDP的影响更大。据我们的估计，2000年代预测值的持续上调对实际GDP增长产生了显著的负面影响。
